codeReview.summary: The commit successfully introduces a React+Vite+TypeScript+Tailwind/shadcn-style setup and wires Go embed serving for dist assets, but it does not satisfy the expected behavior requiring GET /dashboard/ to serve the React SPA.

issues.description: The handler registers only '/dashboard' (exact path) and not '/dashboard/'. In net/http ServeMux, '/dashboard/' does not match '/dashboard', so requests to GET /dashboard/ return 404 instead of serving the SPA index as required by the feature expectedBehavior.
